repo.name: MetaCubeX meta-rules-dat
repo.note: 官方 geosite / geoip，mihomo 用 .mrs、sing-box 用 .srs；规则名形如 geosite/netflix。

ruleset.name: 局域网与保留地址
ruleset.desc: 私有网段、回环、链路本地与 .local 域名，全部直连，避免被代理规则误伤。

base.name: mihomo 标准基础
base.desc: 端口、TUN、嗅探、geodata 自动更新等通用设置；不包含 dns / proxies / rules，转换时合并进输出。
base.content:
mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: true
bind-address: '*'
mode: rule
log-level: info
ipv6: false
unified-delay: true
tcp-concurrent: true
global-client-fingerprint: chrome
profile:
  store-selected: true
  store-fake-ip: true
sniffer:
  enable: true
  sniff:
    HTTP:
      ports: [80, 8080-8880]
      override-destination: true
    TLS:
      ports: [443, 8443]
    QUIC:
      ports: [443, 8443]
  skip-domain:
    - Mijia Cloud
    - +.push.apple.com
tun:
  enable: true
  stack: mixed
  dns-hijack:
    - any:53
  auto-route: true
  auto-detect-interface: true
geodata-mode: true
geo-auto-update: true
geo-update-interval: 24

base.name: mihomo 极简基础
base.desc: 只保留端口与日志，适合交给客户端自己管理 TUN。
base.content:
mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: true
mode: rule
log-level: info
ipv6: false

base.name: sing-box 标准基础
base.desc: TUN 入站、混合入站、clash_api、缓存文件与 NTP；转换时按 JSON 顶层键合并。

base.name: sing-box 极简基础
base.desc: 只设置日志级别，其余交给客户端。

dns.name: mihomo Fake-IP + 国内 DoH
dns.desc: Fake-IP 模式，国内域名走阿里/腾讯 DoH，国外域名走 Cloudflare/Google DoH，并给代理节点域名单独解析。
dns.content:
dns:
  enable: true
  ipv6: false
  listen: 0.0.0.0:1053
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16
  fake-ip-filter:
    - '*.lan'
    - '*.local'
    - '+.msftconnecttest.com'
    - '+.msftncsi.com'
    - localhost.ptlogin2.qq.com
  default-nameserver:
    - 223.5.5.5
    - 119.29.29.29
  nameserver:
    - https://doh.pub/dns-query
    - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
  proxy-server-nameserver:
    - https://doh.pub/dns-query
  nameserver-policy:
    'geosite:cn,private':
      - https://doh.pub/dns-query
      - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
    'geosite:geolocation-!cn':
      - https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
      - https://dns.google/dns-query

dns.name: mihomo Redir-Host + 加密 DNS
dns.desc: 不劫持 DNS 的模式，适合路由器/旁路由已有 DNS 服务的场景。
dns.content:
dns:
  enable: true
  ipv6: false
  enhanced-mode: redir-host
  default-nameserver:
    - 223.5.5.5
    - 119.29.29.29
  nameserver:
    - https://doh.pub/dns-query
    - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
  fallback:
    - https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
    - https://dns.google/dns-query
  fallback-filter:
    geoip: true
    geoip-code: CN
    ipcidr:
      - 240.0.0.0/4

dns.name: sing-box 分流 DNS
dns.desc: 国内域名走阿里 DoH，其余走 Cloudflare DoH；不含 detour，避免依赖模板里的出站组名。
